article.headline: IU Indianapolis wins 95-61 against Detroit Mercy
article.description: — Jarvis Walker's 20 points helped IU Indianapolis defeat Detroit Mercy 95-61 on Thursday night.
article.linkText: IU Indianapolis wins 95-61 against Detroit Mercy
article.story: INDIANAPOLIS -- — Jarvis Walker's 20 points helped IU Indianapolis defeat Detroit Mercy 95-61 on Thursday night. Walker shot 6 for 11, including 6 for 10 from beyond the arc for the Jaguars (6-12, 2-5 Horizon League). Sean Craig scored 19 points and added five rebounds and seven assists. DeSean Goode went 7 of 11 from the field (0 for 3 from 3-point range) to finish with 15 points. The Jaguars snapped a seven-game slide. Grant Gondrezick II led the way for the Titans (6-12, 2-5) with 21 points and five assists. IU Indianapolis' next game is Wednesday against Oakland on the road. Detroit Mercy visits Purdue Fort Wayne on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
